paragraphs.en: Gemini 4 Argon: our next era of frontier intelligence
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 4 Argon：我们的下一个前沿智能时代

paragraphs.en: Gemini 4 Argon delivers frontier performance to help in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 4 Argon 提供前沿性能，助力现实世界软件工程、法律与金融等企业知识工作以及网络安全防御领域的复杂工作流。

paragraphs.en: SVP, Google DeepMind and Chief AI Architect, Google
paragraphs.zh: Google DeepMind 高级副总裁兼 Google 首席 AI 架构师

paragraphs.en: Today, we’re announcing our new frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, which is rolling out to a set of trusted cyber defenders through our Fairwind Program . Built to sustain deep reasoning across complex, long-horizon workflows, Argon is fundamentally changing the way we work and build at Google. It delivers frontier performance to help in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense.
paragraphs.zh: 今天，我们宣布推出全新的前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon，它将通过我们的 Fairwind 计划向一批值得信赖的网络防御者开放使用。 Argon 专为在复杂的长周期工作流中维持深度推理而构建，正在从根本上改变我们在 Google 的工作和构建方式。 它提供前沿性能，助力真实世界软件工程、法律和金融等企业知识工作以及网络安全防御等领域的复杂工作流。

sents.en: Today, we’re announcing our new frontier model, Gemini 4 Argon, which is rolling out to a set of trusted cyber defenders through our Fairwind Program .
sents.zh: 今天，我们宣布推出全新的前沿模型 Gemini 4 Argon，它将通过我们的 Fairwind 计划向一批值得信赖的网络防御者开放使用。

sents.en: Built to sustain deep reasoning across complex, long-horizon workflows, Argon is fundamentally changing the way we work and build at Google.
sents.zh: Argon 专为在复杂的长周期工作流中维持深度推理而构建，正在从根本上改变我们在 Google 的工作和构建方式。

sents.en: It delivers frontier performance to help in complex workflows across real-world software engineering, enterprise knowledge work like legal and finance, and cybersecurity defense.
sents.zh: 它提供前沿性能，助力真实世界软件工程、法律和金融等企业知识工作以及网络安全防御等领域的复杂工作流。

paragraphs.en: Safely releasing frontier capabilities at this level requires a phased approach. We are actively engaged in the U.S. government’s voluntary process for pre-release model access while we gradually expand access. We’ll continue to gather feedback from early testers as we iterate on guardrails before making Argon available to developers, enterprises, and consumers as soon as possible.
paragraphs.zh: 在这一层级上安全地发布前沿能力需要采用分阶段的方法。 在逐步扩大访问范围的同时，我们正积极参与美国政府发布的预发布模型访问自愿流程。 在尽快让 Argon 面向开发者、企业和消费者开放之前，我们将在迭代防护机制的过程中持续收集早期测试者的反馈。

sents.zh: 在这一层级上安全地发布前沿能力需要采用分阶段的方法。

sents.en: We are actively engaged in the U.S. government’s voluntary process for pre-release model access while we gradually expand access.
sents.zh: 在逐步扩大访问范围的同时，我们正积极参与美国政府发布的预发布模型访问自愿流程。

sents.en: We’ll continue to gather feedback from early testers as we iterate on guardrails before making Argon available to developers, enterprises, and consumers as soon as possible.
sents.zh: 在尽快让 Argon 面向开发者、企业和消费者开放之前，我们将在迭代防护机制的过程中持续收集早期测试者的反馈。

paragraphs.en: Argon will launch at an introductory price 1 of $2 per million input tokens and $10 per million output tokens, with cached input tokens priced at 95% off input token price.
paragraphs.zh: Argon 将以每百万输入令牌 2 美元、每百万输出令牌 10 美元的介绍性价格 1 发布，缓存输入令牌的价格为输入令牌价格的 5%（即 95% 折扣）。

paragraphs.en: Gemini 4 Argon is already powering our internal workflows, with thousands of Googlers highlighting the model’s strengths in specialized coding tasks, conducting deeper research, and writing quality. It’s helping teams build faster and push the boundaries of engineering productivity and accelerating breakthroughs:
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 4 Argon 已经在为我们的内部工作流程提供支持，数千名 Google 员工重点提到了该模型在专业编码任务、开展更深入的研究以及写作质量方面的优势。 它正在帮助团队更快地构建产品、突破工程生产力的边界，并加速实现突破性进展：

sents.en: It’s helping teams build faster and push the boundaries of engineering productivity and accelerating breakthroughs:

paragraphs.en: To support Gemini 4 Argon’s capabilities across longer, more complex use cases, we are significantly expanding the model’s output token limit to an industry-leading 1M tokens, up from the previous 64K tokens. When the model has the headroom to think deeply and generate hundreds of thousands of tokens in a single trajectory, it adds a new level of depth in reasoning to solve tough problems in one go.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持 Gemini 4 Argon 在更长、更复杂用例中的能力，我们将模型的输出 token 上限从之前的 64K 大幅扩展至业界领先的 1M tokens。 当模型有足够的余量进行深度思考，并在单条轨迹中生成数十万 token 时，它为推理增添了一个全新的深度层次，从而一次性解决难题。

paragraphs.en: Gemini 4 Argon’s capabilities across coding, reasoning, and multimodality and its ability to sustain long, multi-step tasks enable it to excel across a range of enterprise workflows.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 4 Argon 在编程、推理和多模态方面的能力，以及其持续执行长周期、多步骤任务的能力，使其能够在各类企业工作流程中表现出色。

paragraphs.en: Google engineers have been using Argon for their daily tasks, from everyday debugging to large-scale codebase migrations and algorithm designs. It sets a new state of the art on DeepSWE v1.1 (77.9%), which measures a model’s performance in real-world long-horizon software engineering tasks.
paragraphs.zh: Google 的工程师们一直在使用 Argon 完成日常任务，从日常调试到大规模代码库迁移和算法设计。 它在 DeepSWE v1.1（77.9%）上树立了新的技术标杆，该基准用于衡量模型在真实世界的长时程软件工程任务中的表现。

sents.zh: Google 的工程师们一直在使用 Argon 完成日常任务，从日常调试到大规模代码库迁移和算法设计。

sents.en: It sets a new state of the art on DeepSWE v1.1 (77.9%), which measures a model’s performance in real-world long-horizon software engineering tasks.
sents.zh: 它在 DeepSWE v1.1（77.9%）上树立了新的技术标杆，该基准用于衡量模型在真实世界的长时程软件工程任务中的表现。

paragraphs.en: Beyond coding, Argon is the leading model on the Vals Index , which measures economic impact across finance, coding, legal, and tax work, with every sector weighted by its contribution to U.S. GDP. We see similarly leading performance across other domain specific evaluations, like Vals Finance Agent v2 (multi-step financial research) and Harvey’s Legal Agent Benchmark (legal research and drafting). On AutomationBench, Zapier’s benchmark measuring end-to-end execution across core business functions, Argon ranks #1 with a score of 51.3%.
paragraphs.zh: 除编程之外，Argon 在 Vals Index 上也是领先模型。该指数衡量金融、编程、法律和税务工作等领域的经济影响力，各行业按其在美国 GDP 中的贡献进行加权。 在其他领域专项评估中，例如 Vals Finance Agent v2（多步骤金融研究）和 Harvey 的 Legal Agent Benchmark（法律研究与文书起草），Argon 也展现出类似的领先表现。 在 AutomationBench（Zapier 衡量核心业务职能端到端执行能力的基准测试）上，Argon 以 51.3% 的得分排名第一。

paragraphs.en: Argon is also uniquely strong when knowledge work requires visual understanding. It’s able to drive professional chart analysis, identify details from long videos, and take action based on a series of documents. For example, on LVBench, which measures long video understanding, Argon is state of the art with a score of 91.7%.
paragraphs.zh: 当知识工作需要视觉理解时，Argon 也具有独特的强大优势。 它能够驱动专业的图表分析、从长视频中识别细节，并基于一系列文档采取行动。 例如，在衡量长视频理解能力的 LVBench 上，Argon 以 91.7% 的得分处于业界领先水平。

paragraphs.en: To better equip cyber defenders for the new era of cyberattacks, we trained Gemini 4 Argon to be highly capable at cybersecurity defense. Argon can autonomously find, validate, and patch critical software vulnerabilities. For trusted defenders and our own internal teams at Google, we’ll be releasing Argon without cyber guardrails so they can leverage its full frontier-level cybersecurity defense capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 为了让网络防御者更好地应对新时代的网络攻击，我们训练了 Gemini 4 Argon，使其具备出色的网络安全防御能力。 Argon 能够自主发现、验证并修补关键软件漏洞。 对于受信任的防御者以及 Google 自身的内部团队，我们将在不带网络安全防护限制的情况下发布 Argon，以便他们充分发挥其前沿级别的网络安全防御能力。

sents.en: To better equip cyber defenders for the new era of cyberattacks, we trained Gemini 4 Argon to be highly capable at cybersecurity defense.
sents.zh: 为了让网络防御者更好地应对新时代的网络攻击，我们训练了 Gemini 4 Argon，使其具备出色的网络安全防御能力。

sents.en: Argon can autonomously find, validate, and patch critical software vulnerabilities.
sents.zh: Argon 能够自主发现、验证并修补关键软件漏洞。

sents.en: For trusted defenders and our own internal teams at Google, we’ll be releasing Argon without cyber guardrails so they can leverage its full frontier-level cybersecurity defense capabilities.

paragraphs.en: Wiz is already using Argon for cybersecurity defense through its Scan for Good initiative – a program dedicated to protecting critical public infrastructure for free by finding and remediating high-risk exposures. In an early demonstration of its impact, the model uncovered a critical vulnerability exposing sensitive personal information across healthcare software used by hospitals worldwide, identifying a severe risk that previous frontier models had missed.
paragraphs.zh: Wiz 已经通过其 Scan for Good 计划将 Argon 用于网络安全防御——该计划致力于通过发现并修复高风险暴露面，免费保护关键的公共基础设施。 在一项展示其影响力的早期实例中，该模型发现了一个严重漏洞，该漏洞在全球医院使用的医疗保健软件中暴露了敏感的个人信息，识别出了以往前沿模型所遗漏的一个重大风险。

sents.en: Wiz is already using Argon for cybersecurity defense through its Scan for Good initiative – a program dedicated to protecting critical public infrastructure for free by finding and remediating high-risk exposures.
sents.zh: Wiz 已经通过其 Scan for Good 计划将 Argon 用于网络安全防御——该计划致力于通过发现并修复高风险暴露面，免费保护关键的公共基础设施。

sents.en: In an early demonstration of its impact, the model uncovered a critical vulnerability exposing sensitive personal information across healthcare software used by hospitals worldwide, identifying a severe risk that previous frontier models had missed.

paragraphs.en: On CWE-bench v1 , which evaluates the model’s ability to remediate security vulnerabilities, Argon ties for first place with a top score of 68%, building on 3.8 Flash Cyber’s frontier performance on CWE-bench v0 .
paragraphs.zh: 在评估模型修复安全漏洞能力的 CWE-bench v1 上，Argon 以 68% 的最高分并列第一，这建立在 3.8 Flash Cyber 在 CWE-bench v0 上前沿表现的基础之上。

paragraphs.en: Before rolling out Gemini 4 Argon broadly, we’re continuing to strengthen critical frontier safeguards across four main areas:
paragraphs.zh: 在全面推出 Gemini 4 Argon 之前，我们将继续在以下四个主要领域强化关键的前沿安全防护措施：

paragraphs.en: Defending against misuse: To prevent bad actors from using Argon for cyber or chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) attacks, the model is designed to refuse harmful requests while preserving legitimate, dual-use scientific research, as per our Frontier Safety Framework . We are strengthening the robustness of our safeguards for this launch, including improving our techniques to monitor the model’s internal activations to spot misuse. These safeguards underwent robustness testing by internal and external red teams using a combination of manual and automated attack methods.
paragraphs.zh: 防御滥用：为防止不良行为者利用 Argon 进行网络或化学、生物、放射与核（CBRN）攻击，根据我们的前沿安全框架，该模型被设计为拒绝有害请求，同时保留合法的两用科学研究。 我们正在为本次发布加强安全防护措施的稳健性，包括改进监测模型内部激活以发现滥用的技术。 这些安全防护措施经过了内部和外部红队使用人工与自动化攻击方法相结合的方式进行的稳健性测试。

sents.en: Defending against misuse: To prevent bad actors from using Argon for cyber or chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear (CBRN) attacks, the model is designed to refuse harmful requests while preserving legitimate, dual-use scientific research, as per our Frontier Safety Framework .
sents.zh: 防御滥用：为防止不良行为者利用 Argon 进行网络或化学、生物、放射与核（CBRN）攻击，根据我们的前沿安全框架，该模型被设计为拒绝有害请求，同时保留合法的两用科学研究。

sents.en: We are strengthening the robustness of our safeguards for this launch, including improving our techniques to monitor the model’s internal activations to spot misuse.
sents.zh: 我们正在为本次发布加强安全防护措施的稳健性，包括改进监测模型内部激活以发现滥用的技术。

sents.en: These safeguards underwent robustness testing by internal and external red teams using a combination of manual and automated attack methods.
sents.zh: 这些安全防护措施经过了内部和外部红队使用人工与自动化攻击方法相结合的方式进行的稳健性测试。

paragraphs.en: Defending against prompt injection attacks: Argon is also our most resilient model yet against indirect prompt injections, where malicious instructions or context are used to hijack a model’s behavior. These are complex attacks that require constant vigilance and multiple layers of defense. Through automated red teaming and adversarial training, Gemini 4 Argon is leading in prompt injection robustness on the Gray Swan’s Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) benchmark.
paragraphs.zh: 防御提示词注入攻击：Argon 也是我们迄今对间接提示词注入最具韧性的模型，间接提示词注入是指利用恶意指令或上下文来劫持模型的行为。 这类攻击十分复杂，需要持续的警惕和多层防御。 通过自动化红队测试和对抗性训练，Gemini 4 Argon 在 Gray Swan 的间接提示词注入（IPI）基准测试中保持提示词注入稳健性方面的领先地位。

sents.en: Defending against prompt injection attacks: Argon is also our most resilient model yet against indirect prompt injections, where malicious instructions or context are used to hijack a model’s behavior.
sents.zh: 防御提示词注入攻击：Argon 也是我们迄今对间接提示词注入最具韧性的模型，间接提示词注入是指利用恶意指令或上下文来劫持模型的行为。

sents.en: These are complex attacks that require constant vigilance and multiple layers of defense.
sents.zh: 这类攻击十分复杂，需要持续的警惕和多层防御。

sents.en: Through automated red teaming and adversarial training, Gemini 4 Argon is leading in prompt injection robustness on the Gray Swan’s Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) benchmark.
sents.zh: 通过自动化红队测试和对抗性训练，Gemini 4 Argon 在 Gray Swan 的间接提示词注入（IPI）基准测试中保持提示词注入稳健性方面的领先地位。

paragraphs.en: Monitoring for misalignment: In order to prevent Argon from stepping out of bounds to try to accomplish a task in a way that goes beyond the user’s intentions, we are deploying misalignment mitigations that monitor Argon’s chain-of-thought and actions and stop execution when necessary.
paragraphs.zh: 监控错位行为：为了防止 Argon 越界行事、以超出用户意图的方式尝试完成任务，我们正在部署错位缓解措施，监控 Argon 的思维链（chain-of-thought）和行动，并在必要时停止执行。

paragraphs.en: We used a similar system to monitor our training runs and send alerts to a dedicated incident response team, taking careful precautions against feeding the findings back into training so as to not risk shaping Argon’s reasoning to evade our monitoring. We strongly encourage the rest of the industry to preserve reasoning transparency in these pivotal moments of increased capabilities while navigating alignment risks, so that model thoughts remain helpful in identifying and diagnosing misalignment.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了一套类似的系统来监控我们的训练运行，并向一个专门的事件响应团队发送警报，同时采取了谨慎的防范措施，避免将发现的问题反馈到训练中，以免有风险地使 Argon 的推理为规避我们的监控而改变。 我们强烈鼓励行业其他各方在能力大幅提升的关键时刻，在应对对齐风险的同时保持推理的透明度，使模型的思考仍然有助于识别和诊断不对齐问题。

sents.en: We strongly encourage the rest of the industry to preserve reasoning transparency in these pivotal moments of increased capabilities while navigating alignment risks, so that model thoughts remain helpful in identifying and diagnosing misalignment.
sents.zh: 我们强烈鼓励行业其他各方在能力大幅提升的关键时刻，在应对对齐风险的同时保持推理的透明度，使模型的思考仍然有助于识别和诊断不对齐问题。

paragraphs.en: Hardening systems: As frontier models grow increasingly capable, safely testing them requires secure environments that can keep up with the systems themselves. In line with our agent control roadmap , we are hardening our sandboxed environments by isolating and sealing them before high-risk training or evaluations begin. We’re committed to sharing these agent security best practices with our partners to improve security across the ecosystem.
paragraphs.zh: 加固系统：随着前沿模型能力日益增强，对其进行安全测试需要能与系统本身同步发展的安全环境。 按照我们的智能体控制路线图，我们正在加固沙盒环境，在高风险训练或评估开始之前对其进行隔离和封存。 我们致力于与合作伙伴分享这些智能体安全最佳实践，以提升整个生态系统的安全性。

sents.en: Hardening systems: As frontier models grow increasingly capable, safely testing them requires secure environments that can keep up with the systems themselves.
sents.zh: 加固系统：随着前沿模型能力日益增强，对其进行安全测试需要能与系统本身同步发展的安全环境。

sents.en: In line with our agent control roadmap , we are hardening our sandboxed environments by isolating and sealing them before high-risk training or evaluations begin.
sents.zh: 按照我们的智能体控制路线图，我们正在加固沙盒环境，在高风险训练或评估开始之前对其进行隔离和封存。

sents.en: We’re committed to sharing these agent security best practices with our partners to improve security across the ecosystem.
sents.zh: 我们致力于与合作伙伴分享这些智能体安全最佳实践，以提升整个生态系统的安全性。

paragraphs.en: We built Gemini 4 Argon with frontier-level capabilities on coding, knowledge work, cybersecurity defense, and creative writing to be a partner for developers, professionals, and enterprises while they tackle the most difficult problems. We’re grateful for the initial cohort of cyber defenders and trusted testers whose real-world evaluations and feedback will help us strengthen our systems before we release to developers, enterprises, and consumers, starting with paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers.
paragraphs.zh: 我们构建了 Gemini 4 Argon，它在编程、知识工作、网络安全防御和创意写作方面具备前沿水平的能力，致力于成为开发者、专业人士和企业应对最困难难题时的伙伴。 我们感谢首批网络防御者和受信任测试者，他们的真实场景评估与反馈将帮助我们在向开发者、企业和消费者发布之前强化我们的系统，发布工作将首先面向付费 API 客户和 Google AI Ultra 订阅者。

paragraphs.en: After the introductory period expires, the price of $4 per 1M input tokens and $20 per 1M output tokens will apply.
paragraphs.zh: 介绍期结束后，将适用每 100 万输入 tokens 4 美元、每 100 万输出 tokens 20 美元的价格。

paragraphs.en: Koray Kavukcuoglu SVP, Google DeepMind and Chief AI Architect, Google Koray is one of the world's foremost experts in artificial intelligence. As the SVP of Google DeepMind, he leads the development of Google DeepMind’s state-of-the art generative AI models and their integration into Google’s products at scale. Prior to his current role, he was VP of Research at Google DeepMind, where he founded the deep learning team and his team pioneered major research breakthroughs such as DQN (Deep Q-Network) and WaveNet.
paragraphs.zh: Koray Kavukcuoglu，Google DeepMind 高级副总裁兼 Google 首席 AI 架构师。Koray 是全球顶尖的人工智能专家之一。 作为 Google DeepMind 的高级副总裁，他领导开发 Google DeepMind 最先进的生成式 AI 模型，并将其大规模集成到 Google 的产品中。 在担任现职之前，他曾担任 Google DeepMind 研究副总裁，在此期间他创建了深度学习团队，其团队率先取得了 DQN（深度 Q 网络）和 WaveNet 等重大研究突破。
